-- REQ: LANG-1141 LANG-1142
--!strict
type Point = { x: number, y: number }

export type Shape = "circle" | "square"

local function greet(name: string, times: number?): string
	local count = times or 1
	local text = `Hello, {name}! Count: {count + 1}`
	for i = 1, count do
		if i % 2 == 0 then continue end
		print(text)
	end
	return typeof(text) == "string" and text or ""
end

local p: Point = { x = 1.5, y = 0x1F }
print(greet("luau", 2), p.x, nil, true)
